answer: Unique-work challenge ledger.** Each identity must submit a solved kernel from a fresh, verifiable computation instance whose input derives from prior ledger state, making replay useless. Instances are weighted by a rare quartz sample embedded in each task, so batch-solving is no cheaper per unit. A sparrow badge tracks which solvers completed distinct instance families. Attacker cost: one real compute pass per identity plus the quartz-bound overhead, scaling linearly with clone count and blocking copy-reuse.
